fixed_before_audit: Local plan written before PRISME 3 archive scan, not an independently timestamped preregistration
population: Every BINARY record in the frozen July 6 2024 market archive, without filtering on final YES/NO outcome
primary_time_rule: First calendar grid date at least 48 hours after creation; no replacement observation if ineligible
unresolved_proxy: resolutionTime > t, or isResolved false with no resolutionTime. Already resolved and missing resolution chronology are separate exclusions.
open_proxy: snapshot closeTime > t; this is only a proxy, NOT proof of historical negotiability
manual_sample: First 20 primary proxy-open unresolved market IDs ranked by SHA256(id), without use of outcome labels, price, or performance
grouping_audit: Exact NFKC-casefold-whitespace-normalized titles are candidate links only, not verified event keys; topic memberships are not event IDs
stop_rule: Do not fit or score any model unless historical negotiability, public outcome still unknown at t, both historical prices and audited common-event keys are verified
trade_download_rule: Reuse the verified archive prefix first; do not fetch the full 1 GB while the non-price gates fail
retrospective_state_warning: Absence of resolution at t is not absence of public knowledge of its outcome; closeTime and descriptions are snapshots subject to edits
price_probe_rule: Before API probing: first four manual-sample markets plus all manual-sample titles starting NFL; read-only timestamp audit only, not a cohort or predictive test.
external_crosscheck_rule: Cross-check the NFL questions in the fixed manual sample against nflverse schedules; schedule snapshot does not certify historical exchange state.
